summary: Tested the report's main claim: concurrent carts holding one inventory item on multiple lines can oversell. The scenario (WIDGET stock 10; cart A 5 pieces, cart B 3 pieces + 2 twopacks, completed together) reproduced an oversell in 5 of 13 runs: both orders placed, WIDGET reserved 12 of stock 10, failing no_oversell. The other checks passed. Code reading supports the cause: ensureInventoryLevels in packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts checks each reservation input against available_quantity separately (lines 173-191) and never sums inputs sharing an inventory item and location. I did not test the second-process lost-update (stale-counter-write) defect.
